name: ReduceAny
note: adv_api ReduceAny<T,Pattern::Reduce::AR>(dst,src,tmp,srcShape{dimA,dimR},srcInnerPad): logical 'any element true' along last axis. uint8_t/float only; for uint8_t result is max element (any nonzero -> nonzero). dimA=1,dimR=64. Single 1 -> dst[0]=1. include adv_api/reduce/reduce.h.
